WITH region_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3 as region,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
      WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
      ELSE NULL
    END) as avg_amount,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
cross_region_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as mean_avg
  FROM region_stats
),
filtered_regions AS (
  SELECT 
    rs.avg_amount,
    rs.transaction_count,
    crm.mean_avg
  FROM region_stats rs
  CROSS JOIN cross_region_mean crm
  WHERE rs.avg_amount > crm.mean_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_amount) as mean_of_averages,
  AVG(transaction_count) as mean_of_counts,
  AVG(avg_amount - mean_avg) as mean_excess
FROM filtered_regions

assumptions.assumption: Regions with no PRIJEM or VYDAJ transactions have NULL average, excluded from the cross-region mean calculation. VYBER and other undocumented transaction types are excluded from the average calculation per the requirement.

alternatives.interpretation: Regions with only VYBER/other types (no PRIJEM/VYDAJ) are treated as having average 0 instead of NULL, and are included in the cross-region mean calculation with equal weight.
